task_definition.task_name: DAS waveform frequency spectrum and spectrogram analysis

task_description.overview: Compute and extract frequency-domain attributes (spectrum, spectrogram, f-k transform) from DAS data for analysis of signal content over time and space.
steps: Load the filtered or raw DAS data.
Compute the frequency spectrum (x-t) using an FFT-based method.
Generate the spectrogram (f-t) for all channels or a specified channel range.
Perform the frequency-wavenumber (f-k) transform for spatial-frequency analysis.
Optionally limit channel range using xmin and xmax parameters for spectrogram averaging.

task_definition.agent_prompt:
Using Daspy package to load and compute the frequency spectrum and spectrogram from {das_data}. Compute the frequency spectrum and figure it. Finally, perform the f-k transform and plot figures to show the result. 
 Note: 1) consider use the Daspy to do the loading, computing and figureing. 
 2) Save the frequency spectrum plot to {frequency_spectrum_plot}, the frequency spectrum data to {frequency_spectrum_data}, the spectrogram data to {spectrogram_data}, the spectrogram plot to {spectrogram_plot}, the fk transform data to {fk_transform_data}, and the fk transform plot to {fk_transform_plot}.
